acceptance.criterion_verbatim: IB133-1-AC1 -- the ranking is whole and adds up: one entry per security, sorted, and the counts of securities that cover half and ninety percent of the carried account-days are the ones the list itself gives.
acceptance.output_evidence: OK: 734 securities carry 264720 security-account-days; 9 cover half, 236 cover ninety percent | IB133-1-AC1 PASS | rc=0
acceptance.denominator: 734 securities = 264,720 security-account-days; 9 cover half, 236 cover ninety percent; 34,437 account-days hold an outside-anchor row; same account-days read (v0.35 totals equal the re-count file exactly)

acceptance.criterion_verbatim: IB133-1-AC2 -- the cash rule is counted with no remainder, and the claims re-stated under it sum to the account-days present.
acceptance.output_evidence: OK: 19809 cash-flagged account-days: 19466 stay cash, 0 become OUTSIDE_ANCHOR, 343 not comparable; blank 58.2% of 75796 | IB133-1-AC2 PASS | rc=0

acceptance.criterion_verbatim: IB133-1-AC3 -- every one of the six declared price stores is accounted for (opened or the reason it was not), each security is in exactly one coverage class, the control reads as planted, and no account id is in the outputs.
acceptance.output_evidence: OK: 6 stores accounted for (6 ids); coverage {'every_needed_day': 502, 'some_needed_days': 230, 'no_needed_day': 2}; control as planted; 0 account-id tokens | IB133-1-AC3 PASS | rc=0
acceptance.denominator: 6 of 6 stores opened; coverage 502 + 230 + 2 = 734 securities; control planted equals read (store reader 3 of 3 security-days, cash rule 4 of 4 members); 0 account-id tokens in 2 of 2 outputs
